backtest.summary: Replay the model over a frozen dataset (PIT only).

cpcv.title: Run CPCV validation
cpcv.summary: Combinatorial purged CV + trial grid (DSR/PBO). Family, raw inputs, target, and horizons come only from the immutable model spec; the linked training dataset is read-only.
cpcv.frozenContractHint: CPCV retrains every fold from the model version's linked frozen dataset. The request cannot override model family, input contract, target label, label horizon, or prediction horizon.
cpcv.contractUnavailable: The frozen model contract could not be loaded. CPCV submission is blocked.
cpcv.incomplete: The linked training dataset and runtime config are required.
cpcv.dualTrackHint: Publish requires a single-path backtest (turnover / tail loss / max drawdown) and a CPCV path set (median rank IC / DSR / PBO).
cpcv.sellDualTrackHint: Sell publish requires a lot-level CPCV path set (activity-only lot-native Sharpe / DSR / PBO / rank IC, max drawdown, tail loss, and baseline uplift vs exit-at-first). Empty calendar buckets are never zero-padded. There is no single-path Buy-style backtest for this family.
cpcv.sellSummary: Sell CPCV uses the exact family, target, horizons, and inputs frozen by the model spec, plus a residual-shares state machine (stops on path divergence after partial exit) and activity-only lot-native returns for DSR/PBO.
